# Ape Atoll

Marim and the Monkey Madness jungle (quests/quest_mm npcs). Reached by Monkey Madness's rides, Waydar's glider to Crash Island (quests/quest_mm/scripts/mm_waydar.rs2:116) then Lumdo's boat (mm_lumdo.rs2:24), which teleport from npc dialogue rather than a sail proc, so the transport table has no row for them and the world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn does not reach the island (build.ts unreached report).
